description: Dunit musl port (M6-B) clock + sleep — clock_gettime over the native ClockGetTime and nanosleep over the native Sleep. userspace/ctests/musl_time.c samples CLOCK_MONOTONIC, sleeps ~50ms, resamples and checks it advanced, and that time() is nonzero (monotonic since boot; no RTC yet). Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_time_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 110

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
clock_gettime + nanosleep ran through the native ClockGetTime/Sleep syscalls
the monotonic clock advanced by ~50ms across nanosleep and time() is nonzero

forbidden.why: clock did not advance or time() was zero
